title.value: The load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: The load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains

extractions.description: This paper addresses the integrated load planning and sequencing problem (LPSP) for double-stack trains. It proposes two different integer linear programming formulations and shows that the LPSP can reduce the number of container handlings in intermodal terminals compared to sequential solutions by on average 11.3% and 16.5% for gantry cranes and reach stackers, respectively.
